title: Privacy
description: What chaseteichmann.com collects when you book a call, and what it doesn’t.

sections.label: In short
sections.html: This site has no analytics, no ads, no cookies, and no third-party trackers. It only collects what you enter when you book a call.

sections.label: Booking a call
sections.html:
When you open checkout, the site asks the booking service for my open times. When you book, it sends your email, company, the time you picked and the projects in your cart, plus the role you’re hiring for and your note if you add them. The service checks that the time is still open and that you don’t already have a call booked, then creates the event on my Google Calendar with a Google Meet link. Google emails you the invite, which includes those details.

Your details are kept only on that calendar event, which I use to prepare for the call. I also get an email that a call was booked, with just the time and a link to the event. Your details aren’t stored anywhere else, shared, or used for anything else. The event stays on my calendar after the call unless you ask me to remove it.

sections.label: My calendar
sections.html: To show open times, the booking service reads my calendar’s free and busy times. It never sees what my other events are or who is on them. To keep it to one upcoming call per person, it also checks the guest emails on calls booked through this site.

sections.label: Your browser
sections.html:
Your cart is kept in the page address, so you can share it as a link. If you switch between the Modern and Retro designs, your choice is saved in your own browser and never sent anywhere.

After you book, your booking is saved in your own browser too: the time, your email, company and role, the projects in your cart, and the Meet link. That is how the “Your booking” page and button work. It isn’t a cookie and is never sent anywhere. It’s removed the first time you open this site after the call ends, and you can remove it sooner on the “Your booking” page.

sections.label: Services used
sections.html: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Booking runs on Cloudflare Workers and uses the Google Calendar API. To stop abuse, the booking service limits how many requests each IP address can make per minute; it doesn’t save IP addresses itself. GitHub, Cloudflare and Google may keep standard technical logs, such as IP addresses, under their own privacy policies.

sections.label: Removing your details
sections.html: To have your booking removed, reply to your calendar invite and I’ll delete the event.
